EPR support

Plan for the used oil obligation before the deadline.

India's used oil EPR framework sets recycling obligations for producers of base oil and lubricating oil. Rerol can discuss the current product and documentation options relevant to your case.

Current framework

The 2026-27 target is 20%.

CPCB's used oil EPR FAQ states that the 2026-27 obligation is 20% of the base oil or lubricating oil sold or imported in 2024-25. Confirm the calculation and registration position for your entity before acting.
